title: The Rules
heading: BadCode Shorts: The Rules

beats.name: The stack
beats.blurb: The gang looks up at a massive stack of paper: THE RULES. Sung: "We can't afford a bed for you, / The purse is far too thin."

beats.name: The islands
beats.blurb: A sunny island: a filing cabinet in a hammock under a palm. The profits have a bed. Sung: "There is room on all those islands." Overlay: the tax line.

beats.name: The window
beats.blurb: Out of the window: people sleeping rough in doorways, with dignity. Sung: "But you will sleep in a bin." The organ stops.

beats.name: The tear
beats.blurb: Back inside, the gang tears up the rules. Silence, then each rip of paper is a hit.

beats.name: The pen
beats.blurb: One of the gang holds a blank page and a pen out to camera: your turn.

looks: modern: the gang in today's clothes, today's Britain (looks within it found on the mood board)
